goal: Prevent attackers from exhausting node memory and slowing block deserialization with crafted witness stacks
Reject oversized or malformed blocks and transactions before allocating large memory buffers
agreement: Unaddressed objection: large allocation regression when verifying unknown witness versions (fametrano)
Tested on Windows after implementation suggestions were addressed (Yudis-bit)
Concept approval citing similar issues with exceptional transaction types (instagibbs)
Concept approval without stated reasons (0xB10C, furszy, rkrux, w0xlt)

categories.name: p2p
why: P1 because it hardens network deserialization against remote memory exhaustion attacks
Enforces weight limits and input/output bounds before peers can trigger large memory allocations

categories.name: validation
why: P1 because it fixes an adversarial DoS vulnerability in block deserialization
Reduces peak block memory from 182 MiB to 7.8 MiB and deserialization time from 279 ms to 19 ms
